_note: Energy price cap figures used by tools/build-appliance-pages.js and tools/build-heating-pages.js. Update each quarter from Ofgem (the monthly check task does this) and re-run the generators.

electricity.unit: pence per kWh / pence per day
electricity.basis: Direct Debit, average for England, Scotland and Wales; no VAT on electricity from 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027

gas.unit: pence per kWh / pence per day
gas.basis: Direct Debit, average for England, Scotland and Wales; includes 5% VAT
